description: Per-character step/dodge tuning: duration, cooldown, speed curve, inertia, homing-invalidation distance and step-end animation rate for grounded and airborne steps.

Id.simple: Character ID used as the row key.
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name (exported as ID). ResolveDataRows resolves it via ActionDataTable.Id_ActionStep (or its studio/PvE override) and stores it on the character. Character-specific controllers also look up named rows such as CP_200_AttackH_Behind and CP_200_AttackH_Forward. The export has 14 rows.

CoolTime.simple: End/refractory time of the step action.
CoolTime.technical: Seconds. StartStepCoolTime copies it into StatusController.StepCoolTime; CP_200/CP_270 step actions also end when ActionElapsedTime >= CoolTime (when > 0). CP_010 exports 0.7.

Step_Time.technical: Seconds. StartStepMove returns without starting when Step_Time <= 0; the movement tick moves along the step direction while MovePhaseElapsed < Step_Time, then applies inertia and stops the float interpolator. Homing-step mode uses the same threshold. CP_010 exports 0.2.

Step_Speed_Start.technical: Units/second, multiplied by GetStepDistanceRate() (1 + equipment StepDistance rate) in StartStepMove before FloatInterp28.Start. CP_010 exports 2800.

Step_Speed_End.technical: Units/second, also multiplied by GetStepDistanceRate() in StartStepMove. CP_010 exports 1450.

Step_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the ground step speed interpolation.
Step_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds passed to FloatInterp28.Start. CP_010 exports 0.2.

Step_EasingType.simple: Easing for ground step speed interpolation.
Step_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType converted by ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc. CP_010 exports None.

Step_Blend_Exp.simple: Exponent/shape for ground step speed interpolation.
Step_Blend_Exp.technical: Float passed as the blend exponent in FloatInterp28.Start. CP_010 exports 1.0.

Step_Inertia_Rate.simple: Inertia magnitude applied when a ground step ends.
Step_Inertia_Rate.technical: Passed to SetInertia with EaseOut at the end of step/homing-step movement. CP_010 exports 1.0.

Step_Inertia_Time.simple: Inertia duration when a ground step ends.
Step_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed with Step_Inertia_Rate to SetInertia. CP_010 exports 0.5.

Step_HomingInvalidateDistance.simple: Distance value used to arm the step homing-invalidation timer.
Step_HomingInvalidateDistance.technical: Passed as SetTimer(2, true, value, 0.05f) in the non-grounded branch of the step action and in several character-specific step controllers. Despite the name, GameCharacterAction_Step uses StepAir_HomingInvalidateDistance in its grounded branch and Step_HomingInvalidateDistance in its airborne branch. CP_010 exports 3000.0.

StepEnd_PlayRate.simple: Base playback rate of the ground step end animation.
StepEnd_PlayRate.technical: GetStepEndPlayRate returns max(StepEnd_PlayRate - StepRigidity binding-vow rate, 0.0001f). CP_010 exports 1.0.

StepAir_Time.technical: Seconds. StartStepAirMove returns without starting when StepAir_Time <= 0; the air-step movement tick moves while MovePhaseElapsed < StepAir_Time, then applies inertia and stops. CP_010 exports 0.2.

StepAir_Speed_Start.technical: Units/second multiplied by GetStepDistanceRate() in StartStepAirMove. CP_010 exports 2800.

StepAir_Speed_End.technical: Units/second multiplied by GetStepDistanceRate() in StartStepAirMove. CP_010 exports 1450.

StepAir_InterpolateTime.simple: Duration of the air step speed interpolation.
StepAir_InterpolateTime.technical: Seconds passed to FloatInterp28.Start in StartStepAirMove. CP_010 exports 0.2.

StepAir_EasingType.simple: Easing for air step speed interpolation.
StepAir_EasingType.technical: EGameEasingType converted by ShikigamiMovement_ToEasingFunc. CP_010 exports None.

StepAir_Blend_Exp.simple: Exponent/shape for air step speed interpolation.
StepAir_Blend_Exp.technical: Float passed as the blend exponent in FloatInterp28.Start. CP_010 exports 1.0.

StepAir_Inertia_Rate.simple: Inertia magnitude applied when an air step ends.
StepAir_Inertia_Rate.technical: Passed to SetInertia with EaseOut at the end of the air-step movement phase. CP_010 exports 1.0.

StepAir_Inertia_Time.simple: Inertia duration when an air step ends.
StepAir_Inertia_Time.technical: Seconds passed with StepAir_Inertia_Rate to SetInertia. CP_010 exports 0.5.

StepAir_HomingInvalidateDistance.simple: Distance value used by the grounded branch of the step homing-invalidation timer.
StepAir_HomingInvalidateDistance.technical: Passed as SetTimer(2, true, value, 0.05f) when GameCharacterAction_Step sees IsGrounded() == true and calls StartStepAirMove. This name/branch mismatch is as written in the reconstructed source; CP_010 exports 2000.0.

StepAirEnd_PlayRate.simple: Base playback rate of the air step end animation.
StepAirEnd_PlayRate.technical: GetStepAirEndPlayRate returns max(StepAirEnd_PlayRate - StepRigidity binding-vow rate, 0.0001f). CP_010 exports 1.0.

notes: One exported table with 14 rows; no numbered shards or localization variants for this group.
Ground and air step parameter blocks are parallel; movement modes 0x0F and 0x10 implement them, and mode 0x11 is a homing step that reuses the ground Step_* timing/inertia fields.

In GameCharacterAction_Step the two homing-invalidation fields appear crossed relative to their names: the grounded path uses StepAir_HomingInvalidateDistance and the airborne path uses Step_HomingInvalidateDistance. This is documented rather than normalized.
Step speeds are multiplied by StatusController.GetStepDistanceRate() (1 + equipment StepDistance rate); end play rates are reduced by the StepRigidity binding-vow rate with a 0.0001 floor.
Evidence is reconstructed C++; exported CP_010 values illustrate defaults but do not describe every row. Available Content is partial.

usages.detail: Resolves the required step row from ActionDataTable.Id_ActionStep or its override.
Starts ground step speed interpolation and gates movement by Step_Time.
Starts air step speed interpolation and gates movement by StepAir_Time.
Applies ground-step inertia when the movement phase ends.
Arms homing invalidation timers, with the grounded/air field crossover noted above.
Derives step-end animation play rate from StepEnd_PlayRate and StepRigidity vows.
Copies CoolTime into the step cooldown timer.
Character-specific step action ends at CoolTime.
